evidence.notes: A local test enqueues and drains a Database.Batchable implementation through executeBatch.
A class implements the Database.Batchable marker contract and runs through the local async test drain.
BatchableContext constructs as a passive local context value for tests.
The no-arg context constructor returns an empty passive context.
BatchableContextImpl constructs as a passive local context implementation value.
The no-arg implementation constructor returns an empty passive context.
The local iterator type can be named and constructed as an empty passive iterator.
The no-arg iterator constructor returns an empty passive iterator.
The local chunk iterator type can be named and constructed as an empty passive iterator.
The no-arg chunk iterator constructor returns an empty passive iterator.
Docs expose the access-level overload as Object; local execution receives an AccessLevel value held in Object.
Docs expose the bind-map access-level overload as Object; local execution receives an AccessLevel value held in Object.

source.content: public class BatchPassiveContractsFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Account> { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); Object access = AccessLevel.USER_MODE; return Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE \'Passive-%\' ORDER BY Name', access); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Account> scope) { for (Account row : scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'Handled-' + row.Name); } } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'Done-' + bc.getJobId()); } }

@isTest private class AsyncBatchablePassiveContractsFixtureTest { @isTest static void provesPassiveBatchableContractsAndObjectAccessLevel() { Database.BatchableContext context = new Database.BatchableContext(); System.assertEquals('', context.getJobId()); System.assertEquals('', context.getChildJobId()); Database.BatchableContextImpl contextImpl = new Database.BatchableContextImpl(); System.assertEquals('', contextImpl.getJobId()); System.assertEquals('', contextImpl.getChildJobId()); Database.QueryLocatorIterator emptyIterator = new Database.QueryLocatorIterator(); System.assertEquals(false, emptyIterator.hasNext()); Database.QueryLocatorChunkIterator emptyChunkIterator = new Database.QueryLocatorChunkIterator(); System.assertEquals(false, emptyChunkIterator.hasNext()); insert new Account(Name = 'Passive-One'); insert new Account(Name = 'Passive-Two'); Object access = AccessLevel.USER_MODE; Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Passive-One\'', access); Object locatorIterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(locatorIterator.hasNext()); Account locatorRow = locatorIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Passive-One', locatorRow.Name); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('wanted', 'Passive-Two'); Database.QueryLocator bindLocator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', binds, access); Object bindIterator = bindLocator.iterator(); System.assert(bindIterator.hasNext()); Account bindRow = bindIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Passive-Two', bindRow.Name); Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchPassiveContractsFixtureBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Handled-Passive-One']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Handled-Passive-Two']); String doneName = 'Done-' + jobId; System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :doneName]); } }
